items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And she led the band while we played, she was part of the attraction.

ctx.x: Yes. She was very good at this too. She handled the baton to the beat of jazz music, and she sang. Very, very pretty girl, very attractive girl. And she led the band while we played, she was part of the attraction.
Did they ever made any records?
